ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and money laundering schemes used in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
questions: How did the scheme's leaders launder the money?
What financial institutions were used in the scheme?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme will reveal a complex web of financial transactions and money laundering schemes. This investigation could lead to the identification of additional suspects and the recovery of stolen funds.
